# Ai Kids Games

> Free, open-source browser games for kids: kart racing, farming, tower defense, space adventures and more. No ads, no subscriptions, no sign-ups, no tracking. Every game runs offline from a single HTML file.

Ai Kids Games (https://aikids.games) is a website of original games made for kids, plus the open-source monorepo they are built in (https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games). The site and the games collect no data: there are no accounts, ads, analytics, chat or requests to other websites, and game progress stays in the player's browser. Each game is a single self-contained HTML file that also works offline.

## Games

- [Cliff Valley](https://aikids.games/game/cliff-valley): Great-Aunt Rosemary’s old farm is yours! Grow crops, raise animals, fish, cook, explore a 40-floor mine and help the villagers repair Cliff Valley after the big storm. Ages 8–14. Farming, Cozy, Adventure. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with keyboard, mouse, gamepad, touch. Play time: About 8 hours, plus endless farming. [Play](https://aikids.games/play/cliff-valley) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/cliff-valley)
- [Light Crossing](https://aikids.games/game/light-crossing): Build a cozy life on Driftlight Isle. Befriend your neighbors, fish, catch bugs, decorate a walk-in home and light the old lighthouse for the Lantern Crossing festival. Ages 6+. Cozy, Adventure. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with touch, keyboard, mouse, gamepad. Play time: About 6 hours of story, then endless island life. [Play](https://aikids.games/play/light-crossing) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/light-crossing)
- [TheaBonk](https://aikids.games/game/theabonk): Help Thea push back the Gloom with her glowing Bonk Ring. Dodge waves of cartoon monsters, pick new powers as you level up and survive until dawn. Ages 8+. Action, Adventure. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with keyboard, mouse, gamepad, touch. Play time: 10–20 minutes per run. [Play](https://aikids.games/play/theabonk) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/theabonk)
- [Vanex Defense](https://aikids.games/game/vanex-defense): Command an elemental defense grid. Build and maze towers, counter each wave’s elements, specialize, field a hero and hold the line across six worlds, or build your own map. Ages 10–14. Strategy, Action. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with touch, mouse, keyboard. Play time: 15–25 minutes per sector; 8–12 hours for the campaign. [Play](https://aikids.games/play/vanex-defense) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/vanex-defense)
- [Space Sky](https://aikids.games/game/space-sky): Build your own rocket and fly through the solar system in 3D. Land on planets and moons, meet friendly aliens, learn real space facts and collect space badges. Ages 6–10. Adventure, Learning. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with touch, keyboard, mouse, gamepad. Play time: About 5–6 hours. [Play](https://aikids.games/play/space-sky) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/space-sky)
- [Calex Cart](https://aikids.games/game/calex-cart): Drift, boost and glide through 20 bright tracks in an original 3D kart racer. Win five cups, including the snowy Frost Cup, earn Driving School medals, chase ghosts or race a friend. Ages 10–14. Racing, Action. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with keyboard, gamepad, touch. Play time: About 7–8 hours, plus replay. [Play](https://aikids.games/play/calex-cart) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/calex-cart)
- [Tuck Pop](https://aikids.games/game/tuck-pop): A bright, friendly block puzzle. Drag chunky pieces onto an 8×8 board, fill rows and columns to make them pop, and chain clears into streaks. Classic, Relax, 60 Adventure levels and a Daily puzzle. Ages 6+. Puzzle, Casual. Plays on phone, tablet, computer with touch, mouse, keyboard, gamepad. Play time: A few minutes a game, plus 60 Adventure levels. [Play](https://aikids.games/play/tuck-pop) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/tuck-pop)
- [Agentmon](https://aikids.games/game/agentmon): Join the Field Agent Academy, make friends with 52 cute creatures and solve puzzle Trials to clear the static fog. A gentle pixel-art adventure where nobody gets hurt. Ages 7–12. Adventure, RPG. Plays on computer, tablet, phone with keyboard, mouse, gamepad, touch. Play time: About 8 hours, plus post-game. [Play](https://aikids.games/play/agentmon) · [Source](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/games/agentmon)

## For parents

- [For parents](https://aikids.games/parents): age guidance, content notes and controls for every game.
- [Privacy](https://aikids.games/privacy): no accounts, ads, analytics or tracking; saves stay on the device.

## Build your own

- [Create a game](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/blob/main/docs/CREATE-A-GAME.md): the game contract and the starter template.
- [Example briefs](https://github.com/msoyaph/AI-Kids-Games/tree/main/docs/prompts): the prompts the games were built from with Claude Code.
- [List your game](https://aikids.games/list-your-game): listing on aikids.games is coming soon; requests go through GitHub.
